summary.text: Russell Fry is the incumbent U.S. Representative for South Carolina's 7th District, seeking re-election. A Grand Strand attorney and former state legislator, he served in the South Carolina House from 2015 to 2022 before winning the congressional seat in 2022. He serves on the Energy and Commerce and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: Fry was born in Surfside Beach, South Carolina, and graduated from Socastee High School; he lives in Murrells Inlet. His official biography describes him as an Eagle Scout.

He earned a B.A. in political science from the University of South Carolina in 2007 and a J.D. from Charleston School of Law in 2011, and according to his official biography he was president of the Student Bar Association in law school.
He then practiced law on the Grand Strand for more than a decade, including as an attorney with Coastal Law, LLC.
Fry won a 2015 special election runoff for South Carolina House District 106 in Horry County and served in the state House until 2022.
There he served as Chief Majority Whip and chaired the House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee, according to his official biography.
In November 2022 he won the general election for the open 7th District seat, defeating Democrat Daryl Scott, 64.8% to 35.1%.
In Congress, Fry serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce, with assignments on its subcommittees on Energy; Commerce, Manufacturing, and Trade; and Communications and Technology.
He also sits on the House Judiciary Committee, on the subcommittees on Immigration Integrity, Security, and Enforcement and on Courts, Intellectual Property, and the Internet.
According to his official biography, he lives in Murrells Inlet with his wife, Bronwen, and their son.
